title: reaper performance — index task lookups for the 60s tick
task_body: The reaper loop scans tasks every 60 seconds. With a few thousand tasks the table scan dominated. Add an index migration on the columns the reaper filters by, and add a regression test that times the reaper sweep.
rationale: Migration adds the indexes; reaper.rs's query may be tweaked to hit them; the test asserts the new perf shape.
